arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import zipfile, re, os
SRC='quarterly_report.docx'; TMP='quarterly_report_new.docx'
zin=zipfile.ZipFile(SRC,'r'); infos=zin.infolist(); entries={i.filename:zin.read(i.filename) for i in infos}; zin.close()
xml=entries['word/document.xml'].decode('utf-8')
def is_headline(t):
    L=re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z]','',t)
    return bool(L) and len(t)<=60 and L.isupper()
def under(m):
    run=m.group(0)
    tm=re.search(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',run,re.S)
    if not tm: return run
    t=tm.group(1)
    if not is_headline(t): return run
    if re.search(r'<w:u\b',run): return run
    return run.replace('</w:rPr>','<w:u w:val=\"single\"/></w:rPr>')
new_xml=re.sub(r'<w:r>.*?</w:r>',under,xml,flags=re.S)
print('u tags inserted:', new_xml.count('<w:u w:val=\"single\"/>'))
entries['word/document.xml']=new_xml.encode('utf-8')
zout=zipfile.ZipFile(TMP,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for i in infos: zout.writestr(i,entries[i.filename])
zout.close(); os.replace(TMP,SRC)
print('saved', SRC)
"

import zipfile, re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('quarterly_report.docx')
xml=z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
print('zip ok, entries:', len(z.namelist()))
runs=re.findall(r'<w:r>.*?</w:r>', xml, re.S)
for r in runs:
    tm=re.search(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>', r, re.S)
    if tm and tm.group(1).strip():
        t=tm.group(1).strip()
        underlined = '<w:u w:val=\"single\"/>' in r
        L=re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z]','',t)
        is_head = bool(L) and len(t)<=60 and L.isupper()
        print(('HEADLINE+U ' if (is_head and underlined) else ('HEADLINE NO U ' if is_head else 'body       ')) + repr(t[:60]))
"
